title: Download of crashlytics-devtools.jar fails behind proxy
body:
### New Issue Checklist - [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version - [x] I have read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) ### Issue Description When using the crashlytics action without specify the crashlytics_path path, crashlytics_helper.rb attempts to download the jar, but fails when running behind a proxy. It appears 'Net::HTTP.get(URI(url))', does not use the ENV['http_proxy'] setting as opposed to when using 'Net::HTTP.new(host, port)'. Replacing lines 75/76 or crashlytics_helper.rb with the following block solves the issue: ``` uri = URI(url) httpConn = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port) httpConn.use_ssl=true result = httpConn.request_get(uri.path) raise "#{result.message} (#{result.code})" unless result.kind_of? Net::HTTPSuccess File.write(zip_path, result.body) ``` ##### Complete output when running fastlane, including the stack trace and command used ``` 18:12:30]: ------------------------- [18:12:30]: --- Step: crashlytics --- [18:12:30]: ------------------------- [18:12:30]: Downloading Crashlytics Support Library - this might take a minute... [18:12:30]: Variable Dump: [18:12:30]: {:DEFAULT_PLATFORM=>:android, :PLATFORM_NAME=>:android, :LANE_NAME=>"android uat", :GRADLE_BUILD_TYPE=>"Release", :GRADLE_FLAVOR=>"BusPrevostNonprod", :GRADLE_ALL_APK_OUTPUT_PATHS=>[]} [18:12:30]: Error fetching remote file: Failed to open TCP connection to ssl-download-crashlytics-com.s3.amazonaws.com:443 (getaddrinfo: nodename nor servname provided, or not known) +------+------------------------------------------+-------------+ | fastlane summary | +------+------------------------------------------+-------------+ | Step | Action | Time (in s) | +------+------------------------------------------+-------------+ | 1 | Verifying required fastlane version | 0 | | 2 | default_platform | 0 | | 3 | Switch to android load_envs lane | 0 | | 4 | Switch to android crashlytics_build lane | 0 | | 5 | gradle | 15 | | 💥 | crashlytics | 0 | +------+------------------------------------------+-------------+ [18:12:30]: fastlane finished with errors [!] Error fetching remote file: Failed to open TCP connection to ssl-download-crashlytics-com.s3.amazonaws.com:443 (getaddrinfo: nodename nor servname provided, or not known) ``` ### Environment

Play" lane :deploy do |options| unless options[:skipGITCheck] ensure_git_branch ensure_git_status_clean end beta(options) metadata(options) end private_lane :crashlytics_build do |options| execute_for_flavors { gradle( task: 'assemble', build_type: 'Release', flavor: "#{ENV['FLTANDROID_PRODUCT_FLAVOR']}Nonprod", properties: options[:gradleprops] ) } unless options[:skipUpload] execute_for_flavors { apkpath = `cd .. && ls build/outputs/apk/*-#{ENV['FLTANDROID_PRODUCT_FLAVOR']}-nonprod-release.apk 2>/dev/null` raise 'Unable to find APK' unless apkpath && apkpath.strip.length > 0 crashlytics( apk_path: apkpath.strip, # crashlytics_path:, api_token: ENV['FLTANDROID_FABRIC_APIKEY'], build_secret: ENV['FLTANDROID_FABRIC_SECRETKEY'], ) # gradle( # task: 'crashlyticsUploadDistribution', # build_type: 'Release', # flavor: "#{ENV['FLTANDROID_PRODUCT_FLAVOR']}Nonprod", # properties: options[:gradleprops] # ) } end end private_lane :load_envs do execute_for_flavors { propsFile="../src/#{ENV['FLTANDROID_PRODUCT_FLAVOR']}/market.properties" puts "propsFile=#{propsFile}" unless !File.exists?propsFile env_file = File.join(Fastlane::FastlaneFolder.path || "", propsFile) puts "env_file=#{env_file}" Dotenv.overload(env_file) end } end after_all do |lane| # This block is called, only if the executed lane was successful # slack( # message: "Successfully deployed new App Update." # ) end error do |lane, exception| # slack( # message: exception.message, # success: false # ) end end def execute_for_flavors raise "Nested execute_for_flavors is not supported" if ENV['FLTANDROID_PRODUCT_FLAVOR'] && flavor_env.length > 1 backupENV = ENV.to_hash backupActions = Actions.lane_context.clone Actions.lane_context.clear ENV.clear env_cache.each do |flavor_name, flavor_env| lane_context_cache[flavor_name].each { |k, v| Actions.lane_context[k] = v } flavor_env.each { |k, v| ENV[k] ||= v } yield env_cache[flavor_name] = ENV.to_hash #update flavors hash with any new variables lane_context_cache[flavor_name] = Actions.lane_context.clone Actions.lane_context.clear ENV.clear end backupActions.each { |k, v| Actions.lane_context[k] = v } backupENV.each { |k, v| ENV[k] ||= v } end def env_cache @env_cache ||= {} end def lane_context_cache @lane_context_cache ||= {} end # More
